headlines.title: 중국만 배불리던 전기차 규정 … ‘ 국내생산 세액공제’ 지각 논의
headlines.summary: 작년부터 입법 추진했지만 답보 테슬라 등 韓 전기차시장 장악 이달 국회 조세소위서 심사 예정 이르면 내달 본회의 상정 기대 여야 “자국 산업 보호” 한목소리 정치권이 연내 국회 통과를 목표로 국산 전기차에 생산세액공제를 도입하기 위한 법 개정 추진을 본격화할 방침이어서 주목된다.

headlines.title: 中 공세에 벼랑끝 내몰린 전기차 …“ 생산세액공제 추가 시급 ”
headlines.summary: 전기차, 세제개편안 6대 분야서 소외 22대 국회 24건 발의, 11월 국회 논의 “주요국 관세·보조금 동원” 대응촉구 업계, 일본 수준 대당 400만원 지원안 이형일(왼쪽) 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 정의선 현대차그룹 회장이 2일 경기 화성 현대차 남양연구소에서 면담에 앞서 악수하며 기념사진을 찍고 있다.

headlines.title: 과반 무너진 국산 전기차 …" 전기차도 세액공제 포함해야 "
headlines.summary: 올해 중국 전기차 점유율 43.5%…여야, 국정감사서 한 목소리 지원 촉구 국내생산세액공제 전기차 포함 법안 24건 발의…"마중물 역할 지원해야" (서울=연합뉴스) 장하나 기자 = 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 이달 중에 '전기차 산업 경쟁력 강화 방안'을 마련해 발표하겠다고 밝힌 가운데 자동차 업계뿐 아니라 국회에서도 여야를 막론하고 국내생산세액공제

headlines.title: 10월 소비자물가 상승 률 2.8% ↑… 가공식품·석유류 '들썩 '
headlines.summary: 소비자물가 상승률이 두 달 연속 2%대 후반을 유지했다. 농축수산물 가격은 내렸지만 가공식품과 석유류는 오름세를 이어갔다. 지난달 소비자물가지수는 120.73(2020년=100)으로 작년 동월 대비 2.8% 오른 것으로 국가데이터처가 3일 발표한 '10월 소비자물가 동향'에 나타났다.

headlines.title: 10월물가 2.8% 고공행진 …기름 더 붓는 ‘역대급 예산’
headlines.summary: 서민들 ‘이중고’ 불가피 3일 서울 시내 한 대형마트 식품 매대에서 소비자들이 장을 보고 있다. 뉴시스 10월 소비자물가 상승률이 2.8%를 기록해 석유가격 중심의 고물가 흐름이 이어졌다. 정부가 역대급 예산에 이어 미래대응기금을 통한 돈 풀기에 나설 방침이어서 물가 상승세에 기름을 부을 수 있다는 우려가 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 석유류 14.9% 급등 … 가공식품도 2.9% 상승
headlines.summary: 데이터처, 10월 소비자물가 2.8% 상승 농산물 석달째 하락…석유류, 물가 부담 정부, 김장철 할인에 640억 투입 ‘최대’ 지난달 소비자물가 상승률이 2.8%로 두 달 연속 2%대 후반을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 정부 " 체감 물가 여전히 높아...역대 최대 규모 김장 대책 "
headlines.summary: 권대영 재정경제부 제1차관은 물가관계차관회의를 주재하고 누적된 물가 상승 여파로 체감 물가가 여전히 높다고 진단했습니다. 권 차관은 10월 소비자물가 상승률이 2.8%로 발표된 것을 두고 가공식품 등이 올랐으나 농·축·수산물 가격이 전년 대비 하락하면서 전월보다 둔화됐다고 평가했습니다. 하지만 체감 물가는 지표 물가와 동떨어져 있다는 게 정부의 판단입니다.

headlines.summary: 거시경제·통상·재정정책 논의…정부 "경제 상황·정책 방향 설명" 재정경제부 출입구.  ⓒ 뉴스1 김기남 기자 (세종=뉴스1) 임용우 기자 = 국제 신용평가사 '피치'가 한국을 방문해 국가신용등급 평가를 위한 연례협의를 실시한다. 평가 결과는 올해 4분기 중 발표될 예정이다.

headlines.title: 압구정 50억 이상 거래 45%가 ‘ 집주인 대출 ’ [H-EXCLUSIVE]
headlines.summary: 소유권 이전 11건 중 집주인 대출 5건 20억~60억원대 빌려 대출규제 우회 정부의 강도 높은 대출규제에 강남·서초 등 고가주택 시장에서는 집주인에게 자금을 빌려 주택을 매수하는 ‘셀러 파이낸싱’이 늘어나고 있다. 특히 거래금액이 50억~100억원에 달하는 압구정 일대는 매수대금 절반 이상을 셀러 파이낸싱을 활용해 사들이는 사례도 목격되고 있다.

headlines.title: 청년 취업 어려운데 … 공공기관 채용형 인턴 37% 급감 [H-EXCLUSIVE]
headlines.summary: 9월까지 2903명 그쳐, 체험형 5% 증가 기간제 22% 급증, 단기 일자리 치우쳐 청년 취업난이 장기화하는 가운데 공공기관의 정규직 진입 경로로 꼽히는 채용형 인턴 채용이 1년 새 37% 넘게 줄었다. 반면 일경험 중심의 체험형 인턴 채용과 기간제 인력은 늘었다.

key_headlines.summary: South Korea's consumer price inflation reached 2.8% year-over-year in October, maintaining elevated levels for two consecutive months. Oil prices surged nearly 15% while processed food prices continued climbing, though agricultural product prices declined.

key_headlines.title: Korea-Turkey Strengthen Nuclear Energy and Critical Mineral Cooperation
key_headlines.summary: South Korea and Turkey signed multiple MOUs including nuclear project financing cooperation and critical mineral partnerships. The agreements support Korea's nuclear and defense industry expansion in global markets.

key_headlines.title: Domestic EV Tax Credit Policy Expected to Pass National Assembly This Year
key_headlines.summary: The ruling and opposition parties are accelerating legislative efforts to introduce domestic EV production tax credits to protect Korea's auto industry from Chinese EV competition. The policy is expected to be submitted to the plenary session as early as next month.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Plunges Over 3.6% Amid Global AI Investment Concerns
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock market declined sharply due to concerns about AI companies' funding challenges and profitability skepticism, despite positive signals from falling oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields.

key_headlines.title: Samsung BioLogics Secures 434.3 Billion Won New Contract with Global Pharma Company
key_headlines.summary: Samsung BioLogics signed a new contract manufacturing agreement worth approximately 434.3 billion won through 2031, marking its 9th contract announced this year and raising cumulative orders to 22.3 billion dollars.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's consumer price inflation remained elevated at 2.8% in October, marking two consecutive months above the 2.5% level. Oil prices led the surge with a 14.9% increase, while processed foods climbed 2.9%, though agricultural product prices fell 1.7%. The government announced 64 billion won in support for households ahead of the kimchi-making season. Market analysts expect the Bank of Korea may consider raising interest rates in November given persistent inflation pressures despite domestic consumption weakness.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea maintained its base rate at 3.0% in late September but faces growing pressure to consider additional hikes due to sustained high inflation. Third-quarter GDP showed 1.0% quarter-over-quarter growth, but private consumption declined 0.2%, signaling weak demand despite rising prices. Australia's central bank raised rates to 4.85%, the highest level in 18 years, as global policymakers balance inflation control against recession risks. Government fiscal expansion through record budgets risks fueling inflation further, creating tension between monetary and fiscal authorities.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI plummeted 3.59% as AI-related investment concerns overshadowed positive signals from falling oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields. The NASDAQ decline and worries about AI companies' capital raising needs triggered broad selling across Korean technology stocks. U.S. 10-year Treasury yields remain elevated near 4.93% despite the Federal Reserve holding rates steady at 3.75-4.00%, reflecting market uncertainty ahead of midterm elections. Investors are closely watching how political outcomes will affect inflation, interest rates, and currency movements.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung BioLogics secured its 9th contract of the year worth 434.3 billion won, with cumulative orders reaching 22.3 billion dollars since its founding. The company is executing a three-pronged expansion strategy including production capacity increases, business diversification into antibody-drug conjugates and peptides, and geographic expansion with a new European office opened in August. Korea faces 410,000 job losses in auto parts supply chains if Chinese EV imports continue unchecked, driving urgency for domestic production tax credits. President Lee met with Turkey's President Erdogan to expand nuclear, defense, and energy cooperation between nations.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices face continued instability with only 10-20% of real estate experts and realtors predicting stabilization by year-end, contradicting government expectations. Listings are accumulating and loan regulations have tightened, triggering a market pause, but broader concerns about rental market turbulence persist. Strong price gains in Gyeonggi Province have been driven by semiconductor and advanced industry clusters, with cities like Seongnam, Gwangmyeong, and Hanam seeing double-digit price increases. Political debate intensified between President Lee's contingency measures for potential housing price crashes and Seoul Mayor Oh's criticism of disconnected policy responses.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. midterm elections loom with 70% of voters dissatisfied with Trump's inflation response, making economic issues the central campaign focus amid Iran war-related energy price hikes and tariff impacts. Trump administration plans to revoke duty-free trade benefits for South Africa and Rwanda, threatening up to 10,000 jobs in markets with 30% unemployment rates. The European Union implemented new 2-euro handling fees on cross-border e-commerce shipments to combat cheap Chinese imports through platforms like Temu and Shein. Congressional composition changes could affect tariff policies, Treasury yields, and exchange rates with major implications for Korean exporters.
sections.AI & Economy: Wall Street executives expressed confidence in sustained AI investment demand, with Morgan Stanley projecting cumulative 10-year investment reaching 10-15 trillion dollars as hyperscalers invest 800 billion to 1 trillion dollars annually. The industry remains in early innings (roughly 2 of 9 innings complete) with substantial growth runway despite near-term funding concerns. South Korea and Japan must scale infrastructure investment to develop AI startups as new growth engines, according to Leyton Technologies CEO. Market uncertainty around AI capital expenditure returns and regulatory clarity ahead of U.S. midterms is causing some companies to postpone multi-billion dollar bond issuances.
sections.Others: The government announced a 650 billion won 'AI Factory Expansion Strategy' to spread successful AI technologies from individual factories to other facilities, suppliers, and industrial complexes nationwide. Alteo Zen achieved record quarterly revenue and operating profit driven by expanded sales of Keytruda subcutaneous injection formulation and new technology exports. Basic pension expenditures will exceed 30 trillion won in 2029, one year earlier than previously projected, due to eligibility expansion and demographic aging, requiring structural reforms. Russian and Ukrainian delegations will meet at the White House on November 5th with Melania Trump's mediation as conflict continues.
